;Arts and culture 
*[[Americans|American]] singer [[Mariah Carey]] performs her concert in [[Jeddah]], [[Saudi Arabia]], despite Saudi [[Women's rights in Saudi Arabia|women's rights activists]] calling for her to cancel it. [https://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/wireStory/mariah-carey-shakes-off-boycott-calls-saudi-concert-60746710 (ABC News)]

*Kurdish-Iranian refugee [[Behrouz Boochani]], incarcerated for nearly 6 years in the Australian-run [[Manus Regional Processing Centre]], is awarded Australia's richest literary prize, the [[Victorian Premier's Literary Awards#Victorian Prize for Literature|Victorian Prize for Literature]] and the [[Victorian Premier's Prize for Nonfiction]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-47072023 (BBC News)]
;Business and economy
*[[Italy]]'s [[Economy of Italy|economy]] falls into [[recession]] for the third time in a decade after declining [[GDP]] growth in late [[2018 in Italy|2018]]. [[Italian Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]] blames the recession on external factors, including trade tensions between the [[United States]] and [[China]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jan/31/italy-slips-into-recession-for-third-time-in-a-decade-economy (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[January 2019 North American cold wave]]
**Several cities in the [[Midwestern United States]] and [[Eastern Canada]] reach record low temperatures for the third consecutive day as a [[polar vortex]] continues to affect the region. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/01/31/us/weather-polar-vortex.html (''The New York Times'')]


;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**The [[European Parliament]] votes to recognize [[Juan Guaidó]] as interim [[President of Venezuela]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/venezuela-eu-parliament-recognise-guaido-president-maduro-european-a8756116.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[Colombians|Colombian]], [[Spaniards|Spanish]] and [[French people|French]] journalists are arrested and detained by [[SEBIN]] agents in [[Caracas]]. All four work for Spanish [[news agency]] [[EFE]]. The arrests follow the [[deportation]] of two [[Chile]]an journalists yesterday. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-france/venezuela-detains-colombian-spanish-french-journalists-idUSKCN1PO2FJ?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Abdullah of Pahang]] is elected the 16th [[Yang di-Pertuan Agong]] of [[Malaysia]]. [http://www.asianews.it/news-en/Abdullah-of-Pahang-is-Malaysia%E2%80%99s-newly-elected-king-46059.html (''Asia News'')]

;Science and technology
*Astronomers announce, through the ''[[Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society]]'' journal, the accidental discovery of [[dwarf spheroidal galaxy]] [[Bedin I]] in the [[Pavo (constellation)|Pavo]] constellation in September 2018.
